'''TK-331''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] stationed on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|First Death Star]] during its construction. He died in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] while performing his duties in the "laser corridors", due to carelessness he stepped into the beam and was disintegrated. His fellow stormtroopers commented on this event just as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] former apprentice, [[Galen Marek]], entered the very laser shaft he had perished in while attempting to [[Battle on Death Star I|rescue the rebellious senators]] as well as his newfound mentor.<ref name="TFU" />
